:::: {.hero}
# Moving Together

::: {.stand}
A movement retreat. What happens when a room full of people stops moving the way
they think they should, and starts moving the way they actually feel, together?
:::
::::

This retreat brings together yoga, tantra and improvised movement, practised
side by side, in pairs and as a whole group. Some sessions ground us in breath
and awareness. Others open space for play and creative expression, where we
follow, lead, mirror and respond to one another, and find out what a group can
do that no one can do alone.

Over the days, a group of strangers becomes a group that moves together. Old
habits soften, attention widens from your own body to the bodies around you, and
there is room to be seen as you are, and to meet others more authentically. No experience is
needed, and there's no right way to do any of it.

Everything happens within clear agreements, with care around touch and
connection, and the freedom to take part at your own pace.
